news.title: Secret Hunt in WoW: Forever with the Night Watchman's Torch
news.description: The hunt for secrets is on in WoW: Forever, and to jump in, you'll need to find the Night Watchman's Torch in Duskwood.
news.details:
With the Secret Finders hot on the trail of a secret that starts on Zephras Isle, players looking to help or complete the secret themselves will need to snag a torch that was initially discovered on the Forever beta.
Night Watchman's Torch Guide Dawn Waker Secret Guide
Hidden in Duskwood lies a slain Night Watch Guard. What caused this poor guard's demise is unknown, but more importantly, players will notice that this slain guard has a quest!
This quest is an instant turn-in that rewards players with the Night Watchman's Torch, an item players can use to help light up dark areas around them. This item can currently be used anywhere in the world except for inns and capital cities.
While the torch is only used in one portion of the secret, it sets a precedent - any new content added in Forever could play a role in future (or even current) secrets, so it's worthwhile for players to seek it…

news.title: New "Dawn Waker" Secret Found in WoW: Forever
news.description: A New extensive quest chain to unlock potentially powerful weapons has been discovered in WoW: Forever, thanks to the Secret Finding Discord!
news.details:
A new, extensive secret chain dubbed the "Dawn Waker Secret" has been discovered in WoW: Forever, thanks to the Secret Finding Discord!
Dawn Waker Overview Guide WoW Forever
Players in the Secret Finding Discord community have helped us put together an extensive guide on what we know so far about this incredibly extensive secret chain, starting in Zephras Isle, requiring the Night Watchman's Torch from Duskwood, and taking players all over the map! Although the current reward for the end is unknown, at the end of Part 1 you will be able to claim Eluvi'ana, a one-handed sword of uncommon quality. It is probably worth keeping hold of this in case you get the chance to upgrade it at some point.
Eluvi'ana

news.title: Drowned City Nerfs & Reduced Population in Zones - WoW: Forever Hotfixes for November 9th
news.description: Blizzard has posted hotfixes for today, which includes many class bug fixes, a nerf to The Drowned City, and reducing the population in zones with significant population.
news.details:
Hotfixes
November 9, 2026
Classes
Druid
The Cooldown Manager no longer shows Berserk, and now correctly shows Lacerate when learned.
Idol of Ferocity no longer lists Mangle as an ability it discounts.
Feral
Fixed an issue where Feral Charge (Cat) was not putting the Druid in combat right away.
Fixed an issue where Natural Instinct was not applying correctly to Lacerate or Pounce.
Fixed an issue where the Pounce Stun debuff was not showing in the enemy debuffs while active.
Hunter
Vulgara the Insatiable and the Shrieklings of Zephras should now belong to the correct hunter pet families.
Fixed an issue causing Hunters to sometimes aggro enemies from very far away by targeting them.
Mage
Flamestirke’s ticks on the ground no longer incorrectly consume clearcasting.

news.title: Blizzard Made Character Creation on Higher Population Faction Increasingly Difficult
news.description: To maintain faction balance on PvP servers, Blizzard has adjusted their character creation system and it will become increasingly more difficult to create a character on the more populated faction.
news.details:
Blizzard wants to maintain as close to a 50/50 faction balance as possible on PvP realms, and is making it harder to create characters on the more populated faction. While realms are at worst a 55/45 split, they want them closer. The more populated faction in each region is:
Horde on PvP NA
Alliance on EU RPPVP
It’s vitally important that the PvP rulesets in WoW: Forever have balanced factions where both factions vie for supremacy, creating memories of epic victories and stunning defeats that we all remember for years to come. While even the most extreme case in a region is currently at roughly a 55/45 split, that is not as close as we want it to be.
To better set the stage for the neck-and-neck conflicts we all want, we’ve adjusted the character creation system to better recognize the overall state of faction balance in each region’s PvP rulesets, rather than what may feel like…

news.title: Level Faster with your Cozy Sleeping Bag in WoW: Forever
news.description: The Cozy Sleeping Bag in WoW: Forever gives you a 3% experience buff and is worth going out of your way for, even though it does take a while to get.
news.details:
The Cozy Sleeping Bag in World of Warcraft: Forever is a quest chain that takes you traveling all around Azeroth. It gives good experience as you go, but the primary draw is that the final stage rewards the Cozy Sleeping Bag. Some players may have been familiar with this quest chain from Season of Discovery, but now that Forever is released, there's no better time to grab a sleeping bag and get cozy.
Collecting the Cozy Sleeping Bag may sound like a bit of a chore that could be skipped, but when you are viewing the path ahead to level 60, it really is a detour you should take sooner rather than later.

news.title: Blizzard Buffs Dungeon Enemy Experience Gains
news.description: Blizzard has just buffed the experience gains from dungeon creatures by a massive 50%.
news.details:
After the dungeon changes buffed experience from dungeon quests and nerfed dungeon experience from mobs, many players adopted a one-and-done strategy for dungeons. Players felt like it was not worth their time to do it again, since the majority of the experience was from the quests themselves. With this hotfix, it won't feel as bad to run a dungeon again if your friends need help.
At about 11:05 PST today, we deployed a hotfix that increased kill experience in dungeons by 50%, so it feels better to go back in for more runs.
Happy dungeon crawling, and good luck with those Deviate Hides!

news.title: Everything About WoW: Forever Raids - Joardee Interview on WoW: Forever
news.description: Joardee interviewed Josh Greenfield and Tim Jones on WoW: Forever and discussed everything about WoW: Forever's raids!
news.details:
Check out Joardee on his YouTube Channel, Twitch, and Twitter.
We've summarized the key points from the interview below.
Raid Philosophy
Tim Jones is really excited about having different raids.
When we go back to Blackwing Lair and Molten Core, they want it to feel familiar but new.
Narratively, they plan to use those raids to mark various points in time.
For Season of Discovery, Scarlet Enclave was super fun and creative, but maybe too challenging.
They maybe pushed things too far at the end of SoD with the complexity of boss fights and tuning.
Will be really exciting when they can reincorporate Scarlet Enclave back into Forever down the road.
They want the encounters to be approachable. Somewhere in the realms of the difficulty and complexity of the Season of Mastery raids and baseline Naxx.
